name: Arya Lodging & Flora Pure Veg Resto
area: Pune-Baramati Road, Morgaon, near H.P. Petrol Pump
signature_dish: Pure-veg Maharashtrian thali for Astavinayak pilgrims
why_it_matters: The closest pure-veg sit-down to Morgaon Moreshwar temple (first of the eight Astavinayak shrines, 80km from Pune). Pilgrim-friendly Maharashtrian thali kitchen with attached lodging, listed on Justdial near H.P. petrol pump on the Pune-Baramati road. The natural lunch stop after Morgaon darshan before the Theur leg.
insider_tip: Open 7am-10pm. Modak (steamed rice-flour Ganesh-favourite sweet) is the symbolic order in Morgaon — temple-trust prasad uses modak too. Cash + UPI.
signature_address: Pune-Baramati Road, near H.P. Petrol Pump + Radha Krishna Temple, Morgaon, Baramati 412304

name: Gurukrupa Pure Veg Family Restaurant
area: Bhondave Wadi, 4km from Morgaon on Morgaon-Supa Road
why_it_matters: Pure-veg family kitchen 4km from Morgaon on the Morgaon-Supa road — broader menu than Arya Lodging (includes North Indian + paneer mains) for groups with mixed appetites. Useful as a non-pilgrim sit-down between Morgaon Moreshwar and the Pune-bound return drive via Saswad.
insider_tip: Family thali (₹250) at lunch is the value order. Paneer butter masala is the kid-friendly safe order for groups bored of thali. Open 7am-10:30pm.
signature_address: Bhondave Wadi, Khandukhairewadi, 4km from Morgaon, Baramati 413115
